-- Migration: backfill customer loyalty level from legacy_code.
-- Mapping per codes.csv.

-- Add the new loyalty column to customers.
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

-- Backfill loyalty from legacy_code using the codes.csv mapping.
UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
    WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
    WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
    WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
    ELSE NULL
END;
